description: Track a team's budget so surprises die young — the commitment-based view (spent + committed + planned, not just invoiced), the category grain that matches how the team actually spends, the monthly close with its one-sentence read, and the forecast honesty for the year-end question. Use when asked track my team's budget, are we going to blow the budget, why did finance's number surprise us, or set up budget visibility for the team.
